g.text: Heatmaps: equal-weight external-cohort means. Curves: LOWESS (span 0.75), recomputed from formal predictions.
Rug marks show predicted probabilities; slope = 1 is ideal. Upward arrows mark CIs truncated at the display limit; labels give true upper bounds.
